item.title: Five exercises to ease and prevent pregnancy discomfort
item.description: Pregnancy often brings aches like hemorrhoids, leg cramps, and sciatica. These exercises may help alleviate and avoid common pains.

item.title: Cambridge professor Jason Arday, accused of plagiarism, found dead
item.description: Arday, who became Cambridge's youngest Black professor at 37 in 2023, was found unresponsive Friday at a home in southwest London.

item.title: White House proposes allowing firms to hack foreign cybercriminals
item.description: A new memorandum lacks specifics but would let private companies disrupt or surveil certain foreign actors.

item.title: Venezuelan soccer player's ICE detention highlights immigration court delays
item.description: The case of Homero Calderón, detained by ICE, underscores the severe backlog in U.S. immigration courts.
